properties.name: Khoohdi, Jaisalmer
properties.description: Located in the outskirts of Jaisalmer, it is a less touristy village. The sand dunes here are enough to keep you awestruck.

properties.name: Mahabar, Barmer
properties.description: A lesser known and small sand dune but the tranquillity, golden sunset along with desert safari and camel ride makes the stay satisfying.

properties.name: Osian, Jodhpur
properties.description: An oasis in the Thar desert with cluster of ruined Hindua and Jain temples from 12th century.
